Still the same as earlier tonight, John. Shop···· is paid but hasn't shipped yet. Your Magic M. 40T is waiting on stock at our US warehouse, and the Harlo OS Diagnostics add-on is on the same order.

Magic M. expects the units to ship out from the factory on November 12, which is tomorrow. Tracking will be emailed to you as soon as your miner ships to you.

You can follow that shipment on its way to our warehouse at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Is something specific worrying you about the order? Tell me and I'll look into it.
